title: US-West-2 Dedicated: Flex Reservations & New instance families launch playbook
creator: Ana K. Soto
description: Goal: Launch Dedicated capacity in US-West-2 with two new instance families and a flexible reservation offering (monthly, 12-month, and hybrid spot-reserve discounts). This ticket is the master GTM playbook coordinating release notes, Console and API changes, pricing/billing configuration, Sales enablement assets, Support runbooks, and partner comms. Focus on predictable throughput for customers migrating from hosted to reserved pools and offering a lower-friction reservation product for small-to-mid customers.
acceptance_criteria: Console: Reservation flow visible in Billing > Dedicated > Reservations and supports monthly and 12-month options
API: /v1/dedicated/reservations endpoints support create/list/cancel and return region, instance_family, term, price_id
Billing: Price IDs mapped and test invoices generated in staging for all SKUs
Docs: Public pricing page and step-by-step reservation guide published and linked from Console
Support: Runbook published with severity/triage matrix and escalation contacts
Launch comms: Release notes drafted and approved by legal and security
Telemetry: Reservation conversion funnel dashboard and revenue forecast dashboard available in Console analytics

release_notes_draft: Feature: Dedicated capacity available in us-west-2 with two new instance families (c6i-optimized, g6-inference).
New: Flex Reservations — reserve capacity monthly or 12-months with hybrid spot discounts; purchase via Console or API.
Improvement: Console reservation flow updated to show expected throughput and estimated per-token cost within the purchase modal.
Note: Early access customers will be migrated to new pricing post-approval; legacy reservation SKUs deprecated on 2025-06-01.
Docs: Full pricing and reservation guide published at https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/reservations-us-west-2
launch_timeline: 2025-02-10: Kickoff — scope and initial pricing approved
2025-02-17: Pricing matrix finalized and shared with finance
2025-02-21: Reservation API in staging; integration tests started
2025-02-24: Billing validation and invoice generation completed
2025-02-28: Internal docs + support runbook published; sales training scheduled
2025-03-07: Public launch and release note publication
post_launch_monitoring: Reservation funnel: visits -> start checkout -> purchase conversion (target conversion >= 8%)
Capacity utilization: dedicated pools and instance family saturation (alert if >80% sustained for 30m)
Billing reconciliation: nightly batch that reconciles price_id usage to invoices (zero tolerance mismatch)
Support queue: monitor for spikes in reservation/checkout errors and page-load time regressions
Quality: customer-reported perf regressions; track mean latency by model and instance_family
notes: Risks: Spot-reserve hybrid may cause confusion — include explicit examples in pricing page and value calculator.
Mitigation: Add an in-Console cost simulator that compares monthly vs 12-month savings for typical throughput profiles (follow-up ticket: PM-7821).
Open questions: refund policy for month-to-month cancellations and prorations (legal working on final language).

Artifacts: Pricing matrix (Drive): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/pricing/us-west2-pricing-v2, UI mockups: https://figma.redwood.com/file/USW2-Reservations, API spec: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/Reservations+API
Follow-ups: Post-launch retrospective to capture support tickets, DC capacity hot spots, and checkout UX friction (schedule in Cycle 2025-W10).
